name: DeepSDF Training Loop
definition: A training procedure for a DeepSDF model that optimizes a learnable latent code per shape and an MLP that maps (latent code, 3D point) to signed distance values using L1 loss.
summary: The DeepSDF Training Loop optimizes a continuous implicit function to reconstruct 3D geometry from point clouds, differing from voxel-based methods by avoiding memory constraints proportional to grid size.
